message.content: {"merge": false, "reason": "The two skills address different diagnostic scenarios with incompatible workflows. Skill A focuses on resolving lateralized anatomical asymmetry (e.g., left vs. right) using direct expert assessment validated by grounding. Skill B focuses on resolving ambiguous pathology presence when the initial expert response is negative/unhelpful, requiring auxiliary tools (report generator, classifier) to identify related findings for indirect inference. Merging them would conflate distinct decision trees: one relies on direct spatial confirmation of a primary finding, while the other relies on inferring a finding from secondary evidence (reports/classifiers) when primary detection fails. Preserving them separately ensures clarity in handling 'asymmetry resolution' versus 'ambiguous pathology resolution via auxiliary evidence'."}
